recommendations.title: Confirm Endpoint behaviour from the log against the documented non-persistent guidance
recommendations.action: Confirm from the Endpoint log what failed at registration and compare with the non-persistent desktop guidance.
recommendations.rationale: The log shows a certificate trust failure at registration and the settings file missing at start; the docs describe how Endpoint behaves on desktops that reset at every logoff.

sources.label: KB: Endpoint shows unregistered after desktop reset

recommendations.title: Explain scope: virtual desktop platform and inspection proxy are third-party
recommendations.action: Tell the customer the VDI profile and proxy parts are third-party and out of scope; their teams and vendors own them.
recommendations.rationale: The late profile restore and the proxy's replaced certificate are third-party behaviour, so no OPSWAT product fix applies. Keep the reply short and clear.

sources.label: Support scope: third-party virtual desktop and network products

recommendations.title: Share the Endpoint server connection and certificate requirements
recommendations.action: Send the documented Endpoint server connection and certificate requirements for the customer's team to compare.
recommendations.rationale: The doc states what the Endpoint client must trust and reach to register; applying it to the customer's own network is their team's job.
